shadows.name: blog-card

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Default glass CTA on dark/cosmic surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-btn-glass:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Admin Primary Button
components.description: Primary action in admin spatial UI — save, publish, create.
components.css: .ds-btn-admin-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: #1ed760; color: #000; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(30,215,96,0.28); transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-admin-primary:hover { background: #3be072; } .ds-btn-admin-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(30,215,96,0.5), 0 8px 24px rgba(30,215,96,0.28); }

components.name: Blog Nav Active
components.description: Active state for blog sidebar/top nav items (warm theme).
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,154,60,0.45); background: rgba(255,154,60,0.1); color: #fff4e8; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,154,60,0.15); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-active:hover { border-color: rgba(255,154,60,0.55); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255,154,60,0.2); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,154,60,0.35); }

components.name: Blog Post Card
components.description: Post list card on blog main — warm theme with top glow line.
components.html:
Next.js와 R3F 번들 분리

Lighthouse 52에서 80으로 올린 기록.
components.css: .ds-blog-card { position: relative; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,154,60,0.2); background: rgba(26,20,36,0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(255,154,60,0.08); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-blog-card-glow { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(255,154,60,0.7), transparent); } .ds-blog-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-syne, Syne, sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fffaf3; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-blog-card-excerpt { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #c9bfc8; } .ds-blog-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,154,60,0.45); box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(255,154,60,0.18); }

components.name: Category Pill
components.description: Category/tag pill on blog cards and detail.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,154,60,0.3); background: rgba(255,154,60,0.1); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #ffd4b0; }

components.name: Admin Spatial Window
components.description: Main content window in admin spatial UI.
components.css: .ds-admin-window { position: relative; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(150%); box-shadow: 0 40px 120px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); padding: 24px; } .ds-admin-window-sheen { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 40px; right: 40px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.5), transparent); } .ds-admin-window-body { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }

components.name: Blog Comment Input
components.description: Comment textarea on post detail — warm theme.
components.css: .ds-comment-input { width: 100%; resize: none; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: #f5f0e8; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-comment-input::placeholder { color: #c9bfc8; } .ds-comment-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,154,60,0.4); }

components.name: Home Navbar Link
components.description: Desktop navbar link on 3D home — slide-up hover animation.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; overflow: hidden; color: #d1d5db; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link-text { display: block; transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover .ds-nav-link-text { transform: translateY(100%); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: attr(data-label); position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-100%); transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview: 3D Blog는 React Three Fiber 3D 홈을 중심으로, 글래스모피즘 UI가 궤도처럼 공개면을 감싸는 정제된 tech 포트폴리오다. 방문자는 먼저 3D 씬에 몰입하고, 블로그·포트폴리오·관리자로 이동할수록 각 존(zone)에 맞는 UI 언어로 전환된다. 전체적으로 어두운 코스믹 배경 위에 반투명 레이어, 부드러운 blur, 절제된 glow가 겹쳐지며 "우주 안의 유리 패널" 느낌을 만든다.
keyCharacteristics: 3D 코스믹 void(#070414)를 앵커로, radial gradient·별빛·네온 glow가 깊이를 만든다
글래스모피즘: backdrop-blur + 반투명 border + inset sheen이 기본 표면 언어
존별 혼합: 홈=몰입, 블로그=고대비 읽기, admin=spatial glass + Spotify-green CTA
Syne display + Geist body/mono — 기술 포트폴리오에 맞는 기하학적 display + 깔끔한 UI 본문
테마별 warm/cool accent 전환 — orange #ff9a3c (light) ↔ cyan #3de8ff (dark)

rules.name: The Link-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: 블로그 본문(blog-prose)에서는 액센트 색을 링크·blockquote border·code highlight에만 쓴다. 본문 텍스트는 #f5f0e8(light) / #e8eef5(dark) 고대비를 유지한다.

rules.name: The Zone Palette Rule
rules.body: 홈 3D는 코스믹 void 팔레트, 블로그는 warm/cool 듀얼, admin은 white/glass + green CTA. 존을 넘을 때 팔레트를 섞지 않는다.

rules.name: The Syne-for-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Display/headline에 Syne, 본문·UI chrome에 Geist. 3D 씬 HTML overlay는 sans-serif fallback.

rules.name: The Blur-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Glass surfaces always pair backdrop-blur-md (12px) or stronger with a semi-transparent border. Shadow alone without blur is not the default glass look.

rules.name: The Sheen Line Rule
rules.body: Chrome bars, cards, admin windows get a 1px top gradient sheen (via-accent/50 or via-white/35) for spatial glass realism.

rules.name: The Pill-for-Tags Rule
rules.body: Tags, categories, admin dock items use full pill radius. Rectangular cards use lg–glass radius, never sharp corners on public surfaces.

dos: Do keep blog prose body at #f5f0e8 / #e8eef5 with line-height 1.85 for readability.
Do use warm orange accent in light theme and cool cyan in dark theme for blog chrome consistently.
Do pair glass surfaces with backdrop-blur and semi-transparent borders.
Do use Syne for display headings and Geist for body/UI in blog and admin.
Do reserve admin green #1ed760 exclusively for primary actions in admin zone.
Do add top sheen gradient lines on glass chrome bars and cards.
donts: Don't use accent colors for blog body text — links and labels only.
Don't mix admin spatial glass palette into blog or 3D home surfaces.
Don't use flat opaque cards on blog without border/glow treatment.
Don't apply heavy box-shadow without blur on glass components.
Don't use generic shadcn gray defaults on blog/public surfaces — use blogTheme tokens.
